mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust residential demand, which typically signals strong consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1200k units.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 3.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and strong job growth (PAYEMS > 100k) indicate a tight labor market boosting corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 100k.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, declining industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) signals weakening manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO falls below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly CPI increase above 0.5% indicates persistent inflation, triggering central bank rate hikes that reduce equity valuations and cause negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 1.5% year-over-year signals strong economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 1.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in retail sales (RSAFS > 0.8%) and housing starts (HOUST > 1300k) indicate robust consumer and housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 0.8% and HOUST > 1300k.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a declining unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, boosting corporate hiring and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE declines.
